               -- Link ảnh/file chứng chỉ\n48\t  cccd_url         TEXT,                   -- Link ảnh CCCD/ID card\n49\t  status           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'\n50\t                   CHECK TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()\n54\t);\n55\t\n56\t-- Index để query nhanh theo status và user_id\n57\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tutor_profiles_status  ON tutor_profiles(status);\n58\tCREATE INDEX IF và google_id\n22\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_email     ON users(email);\n23\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_google_id ON users(google_id);\n24\t\n25\t-- Tự động cập nhật updated_at khi OR REPLACE TRIGGER set_updated_at\n35\tBEFORE UPDATE ON users\n36\tFOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();\n37\t\n38\t\n39\t-- ── Bảng tutor_profiles (NEW) ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n40\t-- Lưu hồ sơ đăng ký gia sư, gồm thông tin cá nhân, chứng chỉ và trạng thái duyệt\n41\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tutor_profiles (\n42\t  id               UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n43\t  user_id          UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n44\t  bio              TEXT,                    -- Giới thiệu bản TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()\n54\t);\n55\t\n56\t-- Index để query nhanh theo status và user_id\n57\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tutor_profiles_status  ON tutor_profiles(status);\n58\tCREATE INDEX IF Vui lòng đăng nhập.\",\n483\t    });\n484\t  } catch (err) {\n485\t    console.error(\"check-email error:\", err);\n486\t    return res.status(500).json({ message: \"Server error.\" });\n487\t  }\n488\t});\n489\t\n490\t// ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ POST /api/auth/register ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n491\t// ─É─âng k├╜ bß║▒ng email + password\n492\tapp.post(\"/api/auth/register\", async (req, res) => {\n493\t  try {\n494\t    const { fullName, email, password, role } = req.body || {};\n495\t\n496\t    // Validate\n497\t    if (!fullName || !email || !password) {\n498\t      return res\n499\t        .status(400)\n500\t        .json({ message: \"Full name, email and password are required.\" });\n501\t    }\n502\t    if (password.length < 8) {\n503\t      return res\n504\t        .status(400)\n505\t        .json({ message: \"Password must be at least 8 characters.\" });\n506\t    }\n507\t\n508\t    const allowedRoles = [\"student\", \"parent\", \"tutor\"];\n509\t    const userRole = allowedRoles.includes(role) ? role : \"student\";\n510\t\n511\t    // Kiß╗âm tra email ─æ├ú tß╗ôn tß║íi ch╞░a\n512\t    const existing = await pool.query(\n513\t      \"SELECT id, google_id FROM users WHERE email = $1\",\n514\t      [email.toLowerCase().trim()]\n515\t    );\n516\t    if (existing.rows.length > 0) {\n517\t      if (existing.rows[0].google_id) {\n518\t        return res.status(409).json({\n519\t          message: \"Email này đã được đăng ký qua Google. Vui lòng đăng nhập bằng Google.\",\n520\t          isGoogleAccount: true,\n521\t        });\n522\t      }\n523\t      return res\n524\t        .status(409)\n525\t        .json({ message: \"Email already registered. Please sign in.\" });\n526\t    }\n527\t\n528\t    // Hash password\n529\t    const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(password, 12);\n530\t\n531\t    // Tß║ío user mß╗¢i\n532\t    const result = await pool.query(\n533\t      `INSERT INTO users (full_name, email, password_hash, role)\n534\t       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)\n535\t       RETURNING id, full_name, email, role, picture, created_at`,\n536\t      [fullName.trim(), email.toLowerCase().trim(), passwordHash, userRole]\n537\t    );\n538\t\n539\t    const newUser = result.rows[0];\n540\t    const token = createToken(newUser);\n541\t\n542\t    return res.status(201).json({\n543\t      token,\n544\t      user: {\n545\t        id: newUser.id,\n546\t        name: newUser.full_name,\n547\t        email: newUser.email,\n548\t        role: newUser.role,\n549\t        picture: newUser.picture,\n550\t      },\n551\t    });\n552\t  } catch (error) {\n553\t    console.error(\"Register error:\", error);\n554\t    return res.status(500).json({ message: \"Server error. Please try again.\" });\n555\t  }\n556\t});\n557\t\n558\t// ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ POST /api/auth/forgot-password/request-otp ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n559\tapp.post(\"/api/auth/forgot-password/request-otp\", async (req, res) => {\n560\t  try {\n561\t    const { email } = req.body || {};\n562\t    if (!email) {\n563\t      return res.status(400).json({ message: \"Email is required.\" });\n564\t    }\n565\t\n566\t    const result = await pool.query(\"SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE email = $1\", [email.toLowerCase().trim()]);\n567\t    if (result.rows.length === 0) {\n568\t      // Don't reveal if email exists or not, just return success\n569\t      return res.json({ message: \"Nß║┐u email tß╗ôn tß║íi, OTP ─æ├ú ─æ╞░ß╗úc gß╗¡i.\" });\n570\t    }\n571\t\n572\t    // Generate 6-digit OTP\n573\t    const otp = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString();\n574\t    const expiry = new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000); // 10 minutes\n575\t\n576\t    await pool.query(\n577\t      \"UPDATE users SET reset_otp = $1, reset_otp_expiry = $2 WHERE email = $3\",\n578\t      [otp, expiry, result.rows[0].email]\n579\t    );\n580\t\n581\t    // Send email without blocking\n582\t    sendPasswordResetEmail(result.rows[0].email, otp).catch(console.error);\n583\t\n584\t    return res.json({ message: \"OTP ─æ├ú ─æ╞░ß╗úc gß╗¡i ─æß║┐n email cß╗ºa bß║ín.\" });\n585\t  } catch (error) {\n586\t    console.error(\"Request OTP error:\", error);\n587\t    return res.status(500).json({ message: \"Server error.\" });\n588\t  }\n589\t});\n590\t\n591\t// ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ POST /api/auth/forgot-password/reset ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n592\tapp.post(\"/api/auth/forgot-password/reset\", async (req, res) => {\n593\t  try {\n594\t    const { email, otp, newPassword } = req.body || {};\n595\t    if (!email || !otp || !newPassword) {\n596\t      return res.status(400).json({ message: \"Thiß║┐u th├┤ng tin y├¬u cß║ºu.\" });\n597\t    }\n598\t\n599\t    if (newPassword.length < 8) {\n600\t      return res.status(400).json({ message: \"Mß║¡t khß║⌐u phß║úi d├ái ├¡t nhß║Ñt 8 k├╜ tß╗▒.\" });\n601\t    }\n602\t\n603\t    const result = await pool.query(\n604\t      \"SELECT id, reset_otp, reset_otp_expiry FROM users WHERE email = $1\",\n605\t      [email.toLowerCase().trim()]\n606\t    );\n607\t\n608\t    if (result.rows.length === 0) {\n609\t      return res.status(400).json({ message: \"OTP kh├┤ng hß╗úp lß╗ç hoß║╖c ─æ├ú hß║┐t hß║ín.\" });\n610\t    }\n611\t\n612\t    const user = result.rows[0];\n613\t\n614\t    if (!user.reset_otp || user.reset_otp !== otp.trim()) {\n615\t      return res.status(400).json({ message: \"M├ú OTP kh├┤ng ch├¡nh x├íc.\" });\n616\t    }\n617\t\n618\t    if (new Date() > new Date(user.reset_otp_expiry)) {\n619\t      return res.status(400).json({ message: \"M├ú OTP ─æ├ú hß║┐t hß║ín. Vui l├▓ng y├¬u cß║ºu lß║íi.\" });\n620\t    }\n621\t\n622\t    // OTP hß╗úp lß╗ç, tiß║┐n h├ánh ─æß╗òi mß║¡t khß║⌐u\n623\t    const saltRounds = 12;\n624\t    const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, saltRounds);\n625\t\n626\t    await pool.query(\n627\t      \"UPDATE users SET password_hash = $1, reset_otp = NULL, reset_otp_expiry = NULL WHERE id = $2\",\n628\t      [passwordHash, user.id]\n629\t    );\n630\t\n631\t    return res.json({ message: \"─Éß║╖t lß║íi mß║¡t khß║⌐u th├ánh c├┤ng!\" });\n632\t  } catch (error) {\n633\t    console.error(\"Reset password error:\", error);\n634\t    return res.status(500).json({ message: \"Server error.\" });\n635\t  }\n636\t});\n637\t\n638\t// ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ POST /api/auth/login ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ
